props.description: A note about the inventory.

props.label: Quantity
props.description: What is the inventory quantity?

props.label: Status
props.description: This is the name of the inventory status - Label field

props.label: Location
props.description: This is the name of the facility - Label field (REQUIRED)

props.label: Lot
props.description: This is either an autosequence, if lotNumberSchema is Null for the product, or use lotNumberSchema as formula variable to drive lot number.

props.label: Master
props.description: This is the master inventory unique number - Label field

props.label: Packaging
props.description: Packaging Material code - Label field (REQUIRED, UNIQUE)

props.label: Process
props.description: concatenated field human-readable  Label Field (REQUIRED)

props.label: Receipt/Line
props.description: Receipt number

props.label: Supplier
props.description: The code for this supplier.

props.label: Work Order
props.description: Label field, and the number of the Work Order.

props.label: Work Order Process
props.description: Label field, code to track the work order process.

props.label: Barcode
props.description: Inventory barcode

props.label: Id
props.description: The primary unique ID of the record.  Every model should have an id field.
